limitations: One assigned packet, indexII.5; all other family rows and supplemental donor rows read for context. No unassigned family packet invented.
Original source and packet differ in anatomical labels, timing and specificity of negative findings.

patient_identity.statement: IndexII.5 is the female proband examined at61, matching packet identity. This is not the last observed age: source follows later dissection about65 and TableS2 biopsyage64.
limitations: Packet lastEncounter61 truncates later published events.

genotype.statement: Source assigns TGFBR1 NM_004612.2:c.1043G>A,p.Cys348Tyr to II.5; packet nucleotide/protein change agrees with familial dominant allele.
limitations: Packet transcript .4 and hg38 coordinate have not been independently normalized against source transcript .2; no raw sequence reviewed.

segregation.statement: Variant confirmed in II.5, deceased brotherII.7 and five presymptomatic relatives; sisterII.2 is an obligate carrier without DNA. Eleven tested noncarriers lacked ascending dilation≥40mm.
limitations: Origin in generationI unknown; age-dependent disease, related carriers and obligate inference limit segregation strength. Follow-up labels a carrier III.2 although Table1/pedigree list III.2 as noncarrier; not silently corrected.

phase.statement: Single heterozygous dominant allele is represented; compound-heterozygous cis/trans phase is not applicable.
limitations: No parental-origin assignment or molecular phasing demonstrated.

causal_confidence.statement: Authors attribute familial LDS/TAAD to this variant using segregation, conserved kinase-domain change and functional cell/tissue findings. This supports source correspondence, not independent clinical classification.
limitations: Only four related patient cell lines; no isogenic rescue or direct allele-specific functional isolation. Increased markers are not uniform: ACTA2 mRNA in Figure2a is lower in patient MYO cells, CNN1 higher and significant; αSMA/calponin proteins significant, MYH11 not marked significant. S1 representative fibroblast blots do not show a detected difference but are not an equivalence test. S2 representative tissue staining lacks quantitative cohort inference.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All22 packet items compared. Root aneurysm and ascending dissection labels conflict with source tubular ascending aneurysm and later typeB dissection. Numerous specific exclusions and positive mitral regurgitation are not established. Cerebral, axillary and other arterial abnormalities are omitted.
limitations: No independent patient charts; no assumption that an unmentioned feature was absent.

assessment.statement: c.1043G>A and p.Cys348Tyr agree with source; familial dominant carrier representation is appropriate.
limitations: NM_004612.4 and hg38 NC_000009.12:g.99144801G>A normalization not verified against source NM_004612.2.

Complete source correspondence review, not clinical truth or independent variant classification. Exact main, nine pages, two figures, one table, two one-frame supplement figures and six-page DOCX all personally reviewed. No wet-lab design/execution.
Historical database absence is an author claim as of publication, not a current database lookup. Raw sequences, underlying blots, tissue series and independent patient charts were not reanalyzed.

SupplementS1 has six stimulated control lanes but only four serum-free control lanes; two patient lines. No equivalence statistics or quantitative replicate data shown. FigureS2 shows two control images and one case per assay, with different casesIII.3/II.5; representative staining is not a cohort effect estimate.

Source inconsistencies preserved: follow-up III.2 carrier conflicts with pedigree/Table1 noncarrier; ACTA2 mRNA plot does not support universal marker elevation in abstract; supplementary immunohistochemistry timing text is internally inconsistent. No protocol repair inferred.

Source genotype correspondence strong at coding/protein level; transcript-version/genome-coordinate normalization remains unverified. Family is related, penetrance varies with age, origin in generationI unknown.
